newsitem.title: INDIA: Nine injured in India garment firm explosion. [CORRECTED 18:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Nine injured in India garment firm explosion. [CORRECTED 18:25 GMT]

text.p: (Correcting title and first paragraph to make clear that nine people were injured instead of killed).
Nine people were injured when a drier in a garment factory exploded in the Indian capital on Friday, the United News of India (UNI) said.
The news agency the cause of the explosion, that occurred in the posh south Delhi area, was not immediately known.
